data.one_liner: Redirects users to an app's page on Google Play or Apple App Store.
data.what_it_does: The plugin provides a static method to open the app's page in the respective store. It supports both Android and iOS and can target the current app or another app by ID.
use_when: Prompting users to rate or review the app
Directing users to another app's store page
Providing a quick link to the app's store listing
avoid_when: When you need deep linking within your app
When you need to open arbitrary URLs or web pages
weaknesses: Only works for store pages, no analytics or tracking
No support for custom store URLs or web fallback
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec, import package, call StoreRedirect.redirect();
